title: Rooms API with ownership checks, OpenAPI document and generated client

tasks.title: Rooms create, list, read, rename and delete with membership checks
OpenAPI document, generated api-client and the breaking-change check

acs.text: WHEN a signed-in user calls `POST /api/v1/rooms` with a title of 1 to 120 characters after trimming THE SYSTEM SHALL create a room owned by that user, make the user its member with role `owner`, store the user's display name and picture from the token in the display cache, and respond 201 with the room (`id`, `title`, `ownerUserId`, `role`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`).
scenarios: A signed-in user creates a room and owns it

acs.text: WHEN a signed-in user calls `GET /api/v1/rooms` THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 200 with only the rooms that user is a member of, newest first.
scenarios: A user lists only their rooms, newest first

acs.text: WHEN a user calls `GET`, `PATCH` or `DELETE /api/v1/rooms/{roomId}` for a room they are not a member of, or that does not exist, THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 404 with `room.not_found`, the same answer in both cases, and change nothing.
scenarios: A non-member cannot see, rename or delete a room

acs.text: WHEN a member who is not the owner calls `PATCH` or `DELETE /api/v1/rooms/{roomId}` THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 403 with `room.forbidden` and change nothing; WHEN the owner does, THE SYSTEM SHALL rename the room (200 with the room) or delete it with its memberships (204).
scenarios: Only the owner can rename or delete

acs.text: WHEN a request body or path parameter does not match its schema THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 400 with `request.invalid` and change nothing.

WHEN the API's zod schemas change THE SYSTEM SHALL keep `packages/api-client/openapi.json` and the generated client types `packages/api-client/src/schema.ts` equal to what the schemas produce, and a check SHALL fail with the command to regenerate them when they differ.
scenarios: The OpenAPI document and client types match the schemas

acs.text: WHEN a pull request's OpenAPI document removes an operation, removes a response property or makes it optional, changes a property's type, or adds a required request property or parameter, compared with the base, THE SYSTEM SHALL fail the breaking-change check naming each change, unless a spec changed in that pull request declares `contract_impact: api-major`.
scenarios: A breaking API change is refused
